domains.name: 01 Sales & Distribution (RtM)
domains.description: Field force execution, route-to-market, distributor hierarchies, beat planning & secondary sales analytics.
domains.scope: Route-to-market (RtM) execution covering indirect distributors/wholesalers, field force sales reps, coverage planning (TCP/TCR), assortment planning (SAO/SAT), trade-channel incentives (TCI/CIP), retail audits, suggested order quantities (SOQ), and order processing.

Concepts & processes.heading: 01 Sales & Distribution (RtM) Core Entities & Mechanics

items.title: Distributor / Wholesaler
items.text: The indirect-RtM intermediary carrying the three sales flows: primary (manufacturer→distributor, sell-in), secondary (distributor→outlet, sell-out), tertiary (outlet→consumer). (Attributes: distributorId, type (WS/distributor, multi-layer), marginStructure, warehouses[], servedOutlets[], dcRdcPlantMapping... Evidence: food major TM&D analytics + a distributor-reporting platform RFP · bakery group / diversified manufacturer secondary-sales model · tobacco major DSS workstream)

items.title: FieldForceRep
items.text: The field seller/merchandiser. Call economics derived per rep: productive-call %, average vs break-even drop size, plan/route/time-standard adherence. (Attributes: repId, ffType (promptSales/preSales/TMR/merchandiser/telesales), supervisor, depot, skillGrade, handheldId... Evidence: field performance-management model · TMD KPIs · salesforce-incentive deck)

items.title: CoveragePlan (TCP / TCR)
items.text: Decides who visits which outlet how often. TCP sets universe/FF-type/frequency; TCR is the periodic capacity-vs-demand review consolidating workload from coverage, assortment, media and incentive plans with scenario levers. (Attributes: outletUniverse, coveredFlag, ffTypeAssignment, callFrequency, callType, workloadMinutes... Evidence: SAO Toolkit · TCR Final process flow · trade-planning analysis deck)

items.title: AssortmentPlan (SAO / SAT)
items.text: Check→Plan→Act assortment object: core range / must-stock lists by outlet cluster, target distribution by SKU, rationalization; SAT is the outlet-level target whose achievement is SAT compliance %. (Attributes: outletCluster, skuCapacityByVolumeClass, coreRange[], mustStockList[], targetDistributionBySku, delistings[]... Evidence: SAO Toolkit (+ SKU Distribution Optimiser & Assortment Generator))

items.title: CallVisit
items.text: The atomic execution event: activities executing plans, surveys, stock count, audit, order capture — with GPS stamp and productive/partial/unproductive outcome. (Attributes: callId, plannedFlag/adHoc, callType, activities[], surveysTaken[], stockCount[]... Evidence: trade-execution scope document · Execution@Outlet user journey · tobacco major Data Dictionary (Call, Survey suite))

items.title: RetailAudit
items.text: Per product × outlet × date: isDistributed, isAvailable (→ OOS derived), facings, POSM inventory, planogram compliance, observed RSP (→ price-compliance index). External twin: Nielsen retail audit. (Attributes: isDistributed, isAvailable, numFacings, posmInventory[], planogramComplianceFlag, photoAuditRef... Evidence: tobacco major Data Dictionary Retail Audit entity · TMD KPI definitions · Indian FMCG major MT OOS/SOS audit facts)

items.title: SuggestedOrder (SOQ)
items.text: Recommendation object: baseline forecast + collaborative-filtering order enhancement → suggested quantity; tracked via acceptance, execution rate, serviceability (~85% baseline accuracy reported). (Attributes: baselineForecast, orderEnhancement, suggestedQty, acceptanceFlag, executionRate, serviceability... Evidence: HPC major S&M analytics deck (AOP/ASOP) · field performance-management model)

items.title: TradeInvestment (TCI) / IncentiveScheme (CIS)
items.text: The customer-facing money: front margin (customer's earn) + back-margin buckets; SONA and CROI derived. CIS: outlet-level incentive schemes with PfP/PfC buckets, enrolment, reward ledger, disputes. (Attributes: frontMargin, backMarginBuckets[], perMille, pctOfCptoNetOfTax, sona, croiIndex... Evidence: legacy trade-platform customer scorecard · trade-terms policy manual · CIS PfP/PfC KPI sub-catalog · B2B Engagement Platform requirements)

notes: Governed scope: Route-to-market (RtM) execution covering indirect distributors/wholesalers, field force sales reps, coverage planning (TCP/TCR), assortment planning (SAO/SAT), trade-channel incentives (TCI/CIP), retail audits, suggested order quantities (SOQ), and order processing.

domains.knowledge_evidence: Evidenced across tobacco major DSS workstreams, beverage bottler Outlet Data Solutions, and bakery group secondary-sales models.

domains.name: 02 Trade, Promotions & RGM
domains.description: Trade promotion management (TPM), revenue growth management (RGM), funds, deals, deductions & claims.
domains.scope: Trade promotion planning and closed-loop execution: joint account planning, promotion calendars, deal creation, trade funds & budgets, price lists & dead nets, lift models & promo elasticity, short-pay deductions and claim settlement.

Concepts & processes.heading: 02 Trade, Promotions & RGM Core Entities & Mechanics

items.title: AccountPlan
items.text: Keyed planning account × brand × year; parent of promotions. Carries volume method (demand-planning baseline / % historic shipments / manual), loaded targets, plan rates, shipment-drop profiles and the approval state model. (Attributes: volumeMethod (B&I Gold/Silver/TVP), tfaTargets (growth%, grossSales$, tradeRate%, slotting$), planRates (sraRate, cashDiscountRate), shipmentDropProfile, stateModel... Evidence: HPC-major TPM program Account Plan/Checkbook/SVP design · consumer-products manufacturer TPM manual)

items.title: Promotion
items.text: The promo event: status lifecycle Draft→Submitted→Planned→Committed→Closed with re-approval on budget breach; tactics; uplift% sourced from lift tables/TPO/manual; grain header→MPG→UPC-week; dead-net-price guardrail. (Attributes: promotionId, status, performanceDates, shipmentDates, promotionType, tactics[] (TPR/display/feature/slotting/overlay)... Evidence: consumer-products manufacturer + the TPM program promotion-planning requirements · beauty major EMEA RFP)

items.title: Deal
items.text: Settlement-facing child of a promotion: variable (off-invoice, bill-back, scan) or fixed (feature, display, slotting, overlay); cost = volume × rate × redemption% or lump sum; identifies the fund/GL it spends against. (Attributes: dealType (variable/fixed), subType, level (header/MPG/SKU), estimatedCost, actualCost, redemptionPct... Evidence: the TPM program Deals & Settlements design · consumer-products manufacturer deductions requirements)

items.title: TradeFund / Checkbook
items.text: Budget container mapped to GL codes with the lifecycle Budget → Planned → Committed → Expended → Free Balance (= budget − committed − expended); live accruals convert liability to expense on shipment; kept open ~1yr post plan-year. (Attributes: fundId, fundType (fixed/accrual), parentChildWithReserve, spendCategories[]→glAccounts, freeBalance, liveAccrualForecast... Evidence: consumer-products manufacturer Fund Management requirements · the TPM program checkbook design)

items.title: Deduction
items.text: AR event — customer short-pays an invoice; matched to deals via resolutions (deal/no-deal), performance date must fall inside the deal window, reason code ties to GL; small deductions auto write-off; repay link for invalid ones. (Attributes: deductionCode, amount, status, reasonCode→glAccount, resolutions[], performanceDate... Evidence: consumer-products manufacturer Deductions/Claims/Settlement requirements · TPM-program as-built)

items.title: Claim / CheckRequest
items.text: Customer- or broker-submitted settlement with deal and no-deal payments; remaining amount = request − deal − no-deal; SAP check/credit-memo round-trip; post-audit and pre-pay variants. (Attributes: claimId, claimType, payments[] (deal/noDeal), remainingAmount, sapCheckNo, creditMemoNo... Evidence: consumer-products manufacturer + the TPM program settlement requirements)

items.title: PriceList / ADL
items.text: Single list price + COGS + dead-net floors per country/division; ADL = account × product intersection carrying retail price, distribution flags with effective dates and store counts per GTIN (drives %ACV). (Attributes: listPrice, cogs, deadNetPriceEdla, deadNetPriceScan, adl: retailPrice, inOutDistributionFlags... Evidence: TPM-program requirements · beauty major price-group spec)

items.title: LiftModel / TPO
items.text: The econometric object: log-log mixed-effects demand model decomposing sales into base / trade promo / consumer promo / competition / halo / cannibalization; true lift & true ROI; what-if simulators and scheme recommendation engines. (Attributes: modelForm (log-log mixed effects), decomposition[], trueLift, trueRoi, whatIfSimulator, schemeRecommender (genetic algo, Lagrange slabs)... Evidence: global brewer TPO approach · beverage bottler Trade Analytics · smokeless-tobacco company workshop)

items.title: GrossToNetWaterfall
items.text: The revenue-side P&L contract between the commercial domains and finance. Three verbatim instances: beer (GT → duty → conditional/unconditional discounts → NT), HPC (GS → SRA → trade → realized → net → GP → marketing profit), tobacco (CPTO net of tax → TCI → supplier share). (Attributes: waterfallInstance (beer/HPC/tobacco), lineItems[], conditionalVsUnconditional, sraSubtotal, totalTrade, realizedSales... Evidence: High Level PnL Structure xlsx · HPC major Customer Profitability reference · tobacco major trade-terms policy manual)

notes: Governed scope: Trade promotion planning and closed-loop execution: joint account planning, promotion calendars, deal creation, trade funds & budgets, price lists & dead nets, lift models & promo elasticity, short-pay deductions and claim settlement.

domains.knowledge_evidence: Evidenced by global TPM solution blueprints, consumer goods trade-transformation models, and retailer deduction clearing workstreams.

domains.name: 03 Marketing & Consumer
domains.description: Consumer data platform (CDP), consumer segmentation, campaign execution, media spend & market research.
domains.scope: Consumer-centric growth engine: multi-source data ingestion, CDP identity resolution, consumer profiles, micro-segmentation, personalized campaigns, media touchpoint mix and continuous consumer research hypothesis loops.

Concepts & processes.heading: 03 Marketing & Consumer Core Entities & Mechanics

items.title: Consumer / LoyaltyMember
items.text: The end consumer with identity, demographics, contactability, tier and points; scored with engagement, share of wallet, churn propensity, NPS, LTV; ~68-column physical schema evidenced. (Attributes: customerId, loyaltyId, demographics, contactabilityFlags, tier, pointsBalance... Evidence: Shopperinsight customer attributes · CVM Data Dictionary · persona decks)

items.title: Segment / Persona
items.text: Segment: typed (value/behaviour/attitude) with parameters, centroids and archived assignments. Persona: narrative instance on micro-segments with propensity-score matching, evolution stages and functional/emotional needs; white-space method exposes underserved segments. (Attributes: segmentId, segmentType, parameters, centroid, archivedAssignments[], referencePersona... Evidence: CVM data model · Persona Development Approach · a vaping product line lifecycle · brewer beer personas)

items.title: Campaign
items.text: Hierarchy Marketing Plan → Program → Stage → Campaign → Wave → Offer → Communication → Response; measured TG-vs-CG with incremental response/spend, cost and ROI; contact-fatigue rules. (Attributes: objective, targetGroup/controlGroup/referenceGroup, channel, sourceCode, wave, offer... Evidence: Shopper Insights user guide · CVM metrics workbook)

items.title: Touchpoint / MediaSpend
items.text: Channel taxonomy (paid/owned/earned × ATL/BTL/TTL × digital × physical) and the Nielsen-style spend record: market → advertiser → category → product → media → network → outlet × period, with companion TRP data. (Attributes: channelClass (paid/owned/earned), atlBtlTtl, mediaType, network, outlet (title/station), spend... Evidence: oral-care major media-spend & TRP samples · Traditional ATL/BTL deck · MPM KPI catalogue)

items.title: CDPProfile / IdentityKey
items.text: Identity resolution: hard keys (phone, email), private keys (cookie, device), soft keys (name, address, IP), unmatched pool re-matched later; pipeline sources → match → unified store → segmentation → activation/syndication. CDP ≠ DMP ≠ CRM distinctions evidenced. (Attributes: hardKeys, privateKeys, softKeys, unmatchedPool, unifiedProfileStore, activationSyndication (DMP/DSP/CRM)... Evidence: Indian FMCG major CDP Technical Solution Design (AWS) · CDP assessment framework · a web-personalization CDP data model)

items.title: MarketResearch / SocialSignal
items.text: MR study objects (U&A, concept test, conjoint/MaxDiff/TURF, NPS, brand equity) across the product lifecycle; social listening signals (mentions, sentiment, influencers, crisis alerts) as command-center consumables. (Attributes: studyType, mode (online/phone/F2F), lifecycleStage, panelSource (Nielsen/IRI/Kantar), mentions, sentiment... Evidence: Market Research Overview · a social-listening platform · Rapid Insight hypothesis library)

notes: Governed scope: Consumer-centric growth engine: multi-source data ingestion, CDP identity resolution, consumer profiles, micro-segmentation, personalized campaigns, media touchpoint mix and continuous consumer research hypothesis loops.

domains.knowledge_evidence: Grounded in HPC consumer insights repositories, beverage brand tracking frameworks, and digital marketing return models.

domains.name: 04 Supply Chain & Procurement
domains.description: Demand sensing, S&OP / IBP, multi-echelon inventory optimization (MEIO), supplier management & network logistics.
domains.scope: End-to-end supply chain synchronization: consensus baseline & promo forecasting, S&OP / rough-cut capacity planning (RCCP), multi-echelon inventory positioning, supplier procurement & PPV tracking, multi-tier logistics network and order fulfillment (OTIF).

Concepts & processes.heading: 04 Supply Chain & Procurement Core Entities & Mechanics

items.title: DemandForecast
items.text: The demand signal: FCSTRPT schema (demand unit/group/location, base vs non-base history & forecast), decomposition into base + influenced demand, driver models (WAS × seasonality × elasticity × calendar), 27-method library + ML, abnormal-demand log. (Attributes: demandUnit (SKU), demandGroup, location, baseHist/nonBaseHist, baseFcst/nonBaseFcst, fcstDate... Evidence: HPC major FCSTRPT export · tobacco major Demand Forecast Workshop (driver-management model) · Anaplan connected planning)

items.title: S&OP Plan
items.text: The 18-month rolling integrated plan run as a monthly 5-meeting cycle with named owners: Product Review → Demand Review → Supply & Material Review → Pre-S&OP → Executive S&OP; extends financially to gross profit and EBITDA with scenarios. (Attributes: cycleMonth, meetings[] (owner, participants), gapClosingActions[], unconstrainedDemand, constrainedDemand, scenarioSet... Evidence: bakery group S&OP IT Roadmap (5 meetings, owners, weekly calendar) · consultancy/Anaplan variant)

items.title: SupplyPlan / RCCP
items.text: Production & material response: requirement analyses, make-vs-subcontract, allocation & sourcing plans, constrained flags; RCCP maps SKU families to factory lines with speeds and scenario levers (speed/OEE, shift pattern, add line). (Attributes: productionRequirement, rmRequirement, makeVsSubcontract, allocationPlan, sourcingPlan, constrainedFlag... Evidence: Anaplan SC planning deck · bakery group planning org)

items.title: InventoryPosition / Policy
items.text: Position per SKU × location (net stock, open orders, inbound STOs, days of supply) and MEIO-optimized policy: segmentation → service targets → optimization minimizing carrying + lost-sales + replenishment cost; slow-moving (>18d) and remnant (>90d) flags. (Attributes: totalStock, netStockAvailable, openSalesOrders, pendingInboundStos, businessDaysOfSupply, segmentation... Evidence: MEIO framework (Anaplan deck) · HPC major SMR reports & stock classes)

items.title: NetworkNode / Lane
items.text: Physical network: supplier → factory → hub → RDC/DC/wholesale point → customer; nodes carry capacity, costs and days-of-supply norms; lanes carry mode, freight cost, lead time, FTL constraints. Redesign is a regular exercise. (Attributes: nodeType, capacity, fixedOpeningClosingCost, handlingCost, dosNorm, lane: mode... Evidence: Network Design & Optimization RACI (Llamasoft/JDA) · industry benchmark (2016/18) benchmark)

items.title: SupplyOrders (SO/STO/PO/Shipment)
items.text: The transactional movement objects: sales orders, stock transfer orders, purchase orders (PO vs non-PO), shipments with carriers and late-reason categories, trailer loads, pallets, invoices (3-way match). (Attributes: salesOrder, stockTransferOrder, transferOrder, purchaseOrder, shipment (carrier, lateReason), trailerLoad... Evidence: HPC major SC metric model & information model)

items.title: Supplier / ProcurementCategory
items.text: Vendor master with OTIF, lead time, reject/waiver rates and scorecards; category taxonomy direct (raw materials, packaging, logistics) vs indirect & traded; savings initiatives with the pipeline identified → approved → budgeted → booked and the finance-to-procurement bridge. (Attributes: vendorId, categoryAssignment, otif, leadTime, rejectRate, waiverRate... Evidence: bakery group procurement org + dashboard vision · strategy consultancy digital-procurement booklet (12 use cases))

notes: Governed scope: End-to-end supply chain synchronization: consensus baseline & promo forecasting, S&OP / rough-cut capacity planning (RCCP), multi-echelon inventory positioning, supplier procurement & PPV tracking, multi-tier logistics network and order fulfillment (OTIF).

domains.knowledge_evidence: Derived from global brewer IBP implementations, food major supply network designs, and multi-echelon inventory models.

domains.name: 05 Manufacturing & Quality
domains.description: Production scheduling, plant operations, shop-floor quality standards, maintenance & overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
domains.scope: Factory execution and operational excellence: master production orders, plant line capacity & changeovers, shop-floor quality inspections (PPM, RFT, DART), loss analysis, and bill of materials (BOM) consumption.

Concepts & processes.heading: 05 Manufacturing & Quality Core Entities & Mechanics

items.title: Plant / Line / Machine
items.text: Region → site → production line → machine → shift → operator; carries line speeds, changeover matrices, raw OEE (observed ~40–50% on real lines) and capacity utilization. (Attributes: lineSpeed, plannedRunTime, changeoverMatrix, rawOee, capacityUtilization, shift... Evidence: HPC major plant financial report + manufacturing metric model · tobacco major global MES program)

items.title: ProductionOrder / BOM
items.text: The make event: planned vs actual quantity, TECO timestamp (→ production lead time), yield, verbatim variance formulas (labour efficiency, material usage/price); BOM with costing and the 42-day on-time release rule. (Attributes: orderId, plannedQty/actualQty, tecoTimestamp, productionLeadTime, yield, varianceSet... Evidence: HPC major manufacturing metric model · quality scorecard)

items.title: Maintenance / Quality / LossEvent
items.text: Maintenance (notification→order, MTTR/MTBF, preventive vs breakdown), quality records (NCR, complaints PPM, RFT, rework/recall, vendor rejects) and the OEE loss tree (availability / performance / quality losses) with waste causality. (Attributes: mttr, mtbf, pmCompletionPct, preventiveVsBreakdownRatio, ncr, complaintsPpm... Evidence: HPC major metric model — manufacturing (verbatim formulas) · tobacco major digital-manufacturing booklet)

notes: Governed scope: Factory execution and operational excellence: master production orders, plant line capacity & changeovers, shop-floor quality inspections (PPM, RFT, DART), loss analysis, and bill of materials (BOM) consumption.

domains.knowledge_evidence: Based on manufacturing execution systems (MES), plant quality compliance frameworks, and line efficiency standards.

domains.name: 06 Innovation & NPD
domains.description: New product development, stage-gate governance, product launch tracking & new SKU commercialization.
domains.scope: End-to-end innovation pipeline: white-space consumer opportunity identification, cross-functional stage-gate reviews synchronized with S&OP cycles, retail launch records, missile distribution builds, and new SKU commercialization.

Concepts & processes.heading: 06 Innovation & NPD Core Entities & Mechanics

items.title: NPDProject
items.text: The innovation pipeline object: gate status, project class, launch window × country, pipeline value (k€) with deltas vs prior snapshot, FY1/Y2 sales & GP%, health RAGs, private-label and on-hold flags. (Attributes: projectId, market(s), brand, skuCount, gateStatus, projectClass... Evidence: bakery group NPD pipeline + 1-pager · HPC major NPI review)

items.title: Gate
items.text: Stage-gate governance: Discovery → Charter → Feasibility → Development → Qualification → SKU/Launch approval → Implementation (or G1/G2 embedded in the S&OP cycle); investment decisions precede approval. (Attributes: gateMeetingDate, approvalType, sandOPCycleLink, ragStatuses... Evidence: HPC major NPD Apr-16 NPI review · bakery group gate labels)

items.title: LaunchRecord
items.text: Per SKU × retailer: presentation date, listing decision, in-store date target vs actual, marketing & production dates, distribution build (store counts, WTD%), price point, exclusivity — reviewed post-launch vs the launchgate case. (Attributes: presentationDate, listingDecision, inStoreDateTargetActual, distributionBuild (stores, wtdPct), pricePoint, exclusivityFlag... Evidence: HPC major NPD Tracker 2016 · UK NPD 2015 summary)

notes: Governed scope: End-to-end innovation pipeline: white-space consumer opportunity identification, cross-functional stage-gate reviews synchronized with S&OP cycles, retail launch records, missile distribution builds, and new SKU commercialization.

domains.knowledge_evidence: Validated by HPC NPD trackers, stage-gate innovation review templates, and launch commercialization playbooks.

domains.name: 07 Finance & EPM
domains.description: Gross-to-net waterfall, customer × SKU profitability, planning versions, standard costing, working capital & GRC.
domains.scope: Enterprise performance management & finance hub: gross-to-net (G2N) revenue waterfall, P&L reporting line item (RLI) hierarchies, planning versions & latest estimates, customer×SKU profitability ladders (whale curves), standard costing & variance taxonomy, working capital management (cash-to-close / CCC), risk & control frameworks, and valuation.

Concepts & processes.heading: 07 Finance & EPM Core Entities & Mechanics

items.title: PnL ReportingLineItem
items.text: The account roll-up (BPC RLI pattern) instantiating a gross-to-net waterfall down to net income; fourth instance: global brewer IBP with MACO (= gross turnover − variable industrial − variable logistics cost) → ZBB → EBITDA → operational free cash flow. (Attributes: rliCode, parent, sign, formulaRefs (ISP%, retention, MPC/statCase), granularityMatrix (SKU vs brand vs company), maco... Evidence: PNL Report by RU and PC1 (beverage major BPC) · HPC major consolidated P&L · Anaplan COE overview)

items.title: PlanningVersion / Scenario
items.text: Version set: actual · plan/budget (annual plan, 1YP) · reforecasts (PPR-n = n months actual + remainder forecast) · latest estimate · prior year · constant-FX variants · scenarios; performance vs posting period; organic flags; ZBB workflow. (Attributes: versionType, pprN, latestEstimate, constantFxVariants, organicFlag, driverBasedInputs... Evidence: HPC major BPC dimension set + Finance MoM (PPR cycle) · beverage group FP&A proposal · global-brewer ZBB)

items.title: ProfitabilityRecord
items.text: Performance-date-based customer × SKU P&L, COPA-extended: full G2N to marketing profit with allocation logic, TPM-liability reconciliation, cost-to-serve extension and the CPP margin ladder (material → contribution → plant margin); whale-curve analysis. (Attributes: grain (customer × brand/MPG × size × month), allocationLogic, tpmLiabilityReconciliation, costToServe, marginLadder (MM→CM→PM), whaleCurve... Evidence: HPC major Customer Profitability reference + solution options · nutrition group CPP · dairy cooperative EPM)

items.title: DebtorPosition / CreditPolicy
items.text: Receivables analytics: ARDSO, ageing buckets with migration % (leading bad-debt indicator), follow-up efficiency, dispute taxonomy, Altman Z-score banding, payer-behaviour segments, insured exposure, provisioning models. (Attributes: arDso, ageingBuckets[], bucketMigrationPct, overduePct, doubtfulRule (>120d), followUpEfficiency... Evidence: nutrition group metric lists + debtor dashboards (verbatim formulas) · HPC major working-capital report)

items.title: PlanningCoE / EPM Model
items.text: The governance object: 4 operating-model structure options, hub-spoke-crew roles, 90-day scorecards and SLA tiers; v1.1 adds the CFO-agenda pillars, the 4-phase finance-transformation lifecycle, the Lagging→Pioneering maturity model, shared-services scope and finance-cost benchmarks (median 1.24% of sales, best-in-class 0.61%; world-class close ≈2 days). (Attributes: structureOptions[], hubSpokeCrewRoles, ninetyDayScorecard, slaTiers, epmMaturity, cfoAgendaPillars[]... Evidence: global-brewer planning-CoE decks · tobacco major Approach for Planning COE · consultancy CFO-agenda deck · FPM practice decks · benchmark studies)

items.title: CostingAllocationModel
items.text: The formal costing machinery: standard costing (4-element system, management by exception) with the full variance taxonomy (material price/usage incl. mix & yield, labour, overhead expenditure/efficiency/volume, planning vs operational), marginal vs absorption reconciliation, two-stage ABC and time-driven ABC, the cost build-up ladder and shared-services chargeback (actual-cost vs standard-price; waterfall/recursive/reciprocal). (Attributes: costingTechnique, standardCostingSystem, varianceTaxonomy, costBuildUpLadder (Prime→Works→COGM→COGS→COS), abcCalculationPath, tdAbcTimeEquations... Evidence: professional-accounting-body costing guides (verbatim) · FPM costing framework & battle cards · worked ABC examples · shared-services costing white papers)

items.title: TreasuryFunction / WC Program
items.text: The instrument-and-program layer above DebtorPosition: treasury lead roles (survey-evidenced), the CCC managed through the P2P / Forecast-to-Fulfill / O2C process triad, working-capital governance splits, financing instruments (reverse factoring, factoring, forfaiting, cash pooling), bad-debt value management, and sector WCR/CCC benchmarks. (Attributes: treasuryLeadRoles[], strategicShift, cccProcessTriad (P2P/F2F/O2C), wcGovernance, instruments[], badDebtValueMgmt... Evidence: treasury-association & pan-European treasurer surveys · Big-4/strategy-consultancy WC papers · FPM working-capital offering · treasury case studies)

items.title: RiskControlFramework
items.text: Governance, risk & internal control: control components (environment → risk assessment → response → control activities → monitoring), risk/control universes with fraud flags, DOA & SOD matrices, KRIs, 100%-population risk analytics, the full P2P policy anatomy (verbatim thresholds, 3-way match, 11 KPIs), and accounting-standard events (IAS 36 impairment, dual-GST mechanics). (Attributes: controlComponents[], riskUniverse/controlUniverse, doaMatrix, sodMatrix, kriRepository, riskAnalyticsMode (100% population)... Evidence: FPM GRC capability decks · risk-analytics offering · GCC services company P2P policy (worked artifact) · Big-4 IAS 36 guide · GST readiness decks)

items.title: ValuationModel / StatementAnalysis
items.text: Financial statement analysis and enterprise valuation: the four-category ratio taxonomy (verbatim formulas incl. DuPont), analytical-restatement plays (LIFO↔FIFO, OBS add-backs, consolidation recasts), enterprise DCF ↔ economic-profit equivalence (EVA/CFROI/MVA), residual-income models, target-multiple formulas from ROIC/WACC/g, and M&A synergy-premium logic. (Attributes: ratioTaxonomy (activity/liquidity/solvency/profitability), analyticalRestatements[], dcfModel (NOPLAT, FCF, continuing value), economicProfitEquivalence, residualIncomeModel, targetMultiples (EV/EBITDA, P/E, PEG…)... Evidence: statement-analysis courseware (incl. a beverage major's bottler-consolidation recast) · strategy-consultancy valuation handbook & model · investment-bank multiples primer · academic EVA/CFROI references)

items.title: EPMPlatformModel
items.text: The technology object finance runs on: the canonical five-component CPM suite (BP&F, profitability modeling, strategy management, consolidation & close, reporting & disclosure), a 17-dimension reference planning model, the ABC allocation engine's calculation path, implementation methodology (phased releases, parallel run, hypercare; failure statistics), and the platform landscape with cloud-vs-on-premise economics. (Attributes: cpmSuiteComponents[] (5), referenceDimensionModel (17 dims), allocationEngine (LineItem→Driver→Activity→CostObject), implementationMethodology, platformLandscape, integrationPatterns (drill-back, audit trail)... Evidence: analyst-research suite definitions (verbatim) · wind-turbine manufacturer 17-dimension blueprint · bank shared-services costing re-engineering · glass-manufacturer phased implementation · platform white papers)

notes: Governed scope: Enterprise performance management & finance hub: gross-to-net (G2N) revenue waterfall, P&L reporting line item (RLI) hierarchies, planning versions & latest estimates, customer×SKU profitability ladders (whale curves), standard costing & variance taxonomy, working capital management (cash-to-close / CCC), risk & control frameworks, and valuation.

domains.knowledge_evidence: Anchored in corporate BPC reporting waterfalls, customer profitability blueprints, and treasury working-capital benchmark studies.

domains.name: 08 E-commerce, D2C & Strategy
domains.description: Digital shelf optimization, eB2B platforms, direct-to-consumer (D2C) channels & omnichannel strategy.
domains.scope: Digital commerce transformation: web & eB2B platform ordering twins, digital shelf analytics & availability, D2C brand stores and subscriber conversion, and strategic channel mix optimization.

Concepts & processes.heading: 08 E-commerce, D2C & Strategy Core Entities & Mechanics

items.title: WebSession / eB2BOrder
items.text: Digital ordering & behaviour: web sessions with UTM/funnel attributes; eB2B orders with order-method (platform vs call centre — the adoption metric), deal incrementality, cart abandonment. Adoption datum: B2B ~40% of sales → 70% ambition. (Attributes: utmParams, funnelSteps, device/geo, orderMethod (platform vs callCentre), customerTier, dealIncrementality... Evidence: global brewer B2B Overall Brief · B2B Engagement Platform requirements)

items.title: D2CLead / FunnelStage
items.text: Direct-to-consumer funnel: leads by source (popup, email capture, referral, SEO), stages acquire → convert → retain → advocacy, HyperCare trial check-ins, party-of-sale (1st/2nd/3rd); common consumer key as the data-maturity gate. (Attributes: lead (email, sourceChannel), funnelStage (ACR), hyperCareCheckIns, partyOfSale, commonConsumerKey... Evidence: tobacco major D2C Activation framework · next-gen products ACR journey · vaping-brand e-commerce performance)

items.title: BenchmarkPeerSet / CategorySegment
items.text: Strategy objects: peer benchmarking (financial levers, operations KPIs, project-level process benchmarking) and category segmentation with per-segment CAGR, share and decline drivers. (Attributes: peerSet, financialLevers[], method (financial/operations/process), market→category→segment, segmentCagr, volumeShare... Evidence: global brewer Benchmarking 2013 + workbook · Market Overview for GAC)

notes: Governed scope: Digital commerce transformation: web & eB2B platform ordering twins, digital shelf analytics & availability, D2C brand stores and subscriber conversion, and strategic channel mix optimization.

domains.name: 09 Data & Analytics Foundation
domains.description: Master data management (MDM), enterprise data quality, hierarchy governance & AI/ML analytics use-case portfolio.
domains.scope: Enterprise data & intelligence backbone: source system integration, conformed fact subject definitions, governed metric dictionaries with role-level line of sight, hierarchy roll-up governance, master data quality defect profiling, and AI/ML advanced analytics use-case deployment.

Concepts & processes.heading: 09 Data & Analytics Foundation Core Entities & Mechanics

items.title: MetricDefinition
items.text: The atom of the measurement system — the metric-model row: name, base data, source system, verbatim formula, UOM, time grains, dimension flags, priority, complexity, owning role, RAG thresholds, non-aggregation rules. 600+ catalogued; the join between business ontology and BI. (Attributes: area/function, metricName, baseData, dataSource (t-codes), formula, uom... Evidence: Metric List Appendix A · HPC major metric models · tobacco major PI Metrics · MT Insights · nutrition group metric lists)

items.title: FactSubject
items.text: The transactional grains a CPG warehouse conforms (13-fact star pattern): sell-in · sell-out · syndicated sell-out · category sell-out · sales plan · estimates · fill rate (8 drop reasons) · OOS audit · SOS audit · asset visibility · promo implementation · competitor promo · P&L actuals. (Attributes: factName, grain (dims subset), dropReasonDecomposition, etlAuditColumns, syndicatedTwin (Nielsen/IRI)... Evidence: tobacco major MT Sales Data Mart dictionary (27 dims / 13 facts))

items.title: HierarchyNode (governance)
items.text: Three governed classes: source hierarchies (maintained in ERP, replicated), attribute fields (governed master-data groupings) and attribute hierarchies (hierarchy-like reporting from governed attributes); MDM obligations to keep mapping/text tables in sync. (Attributes: hierClass (source/attributeField/attributeHierarchy), maintainedIn, mappingTables, textTables, syncObligations... Evidence: HPC major Business Hierarchies position paper · BW InfoObject design)

items.title: SourceSystem
items.text: The canonical CPG landscape (pattern): SAP ECC/BW/APO/DSD/BPC · CRM/SFA · planning engines · TPM · EPOS/retailer POS · EDI · distributor feeds · syndicated data · loyalty/web/social · MES/SCADA/LIMS · 3rd-party feeds; with MDM ownership per object and the lakehouse principle 'no tool connects directly to sources'. (Attributes: systemId, dataDomains[], extractMechanism, latency, mdmOwnership, lakehouseLayer (raw→enrich→serve→consume)... Evidence: Data Assessment Report · tobacco major Data Platform Architecture v18 · HPC major & beverage group architectures)

items.title: DataQualityDefect / MDM
items.text: Logged defect classes (negative sell-in, share >100%, achievement >500%, plan = 0, drifting branch counts, missing history) and the MDM process: maturity ladder, six solution components, field-level CRUD ownership. (Attributes: defectClass, affectedSource, mdmMaturityLevel, sixComponents, fieldOwnership (CRUD per SAP field), numberingStandards (GDS/GDSN/RFID)... Evidence: MT Insights DQ log · HPC major MDM discussion · group data warehouse master-data lists)

items.title: AnalyticsUseCase
items.text: The AI/ML portfolio object: algorithm class, maturity stage (descriptive→optimization), success probability, change-management risk ('planners might think their decision rights are taken away'), measured outcomes (TPO ROI 8→20; suggested order +3.2% revenue; MAPE 9–11%). (Attributes: useCase, domain, algorithmClass, maturityStage, successProbability, changeManagementRisk... Evidence: CPG Advanced Analytics decks · tobacco major planning use-case matrix · HPC major Enterprise Analytics Roadmap)

nodes.name: Product / SKU
nodes.definition: The sellable item and its roll-ups. Two evidenced hierarchy patterns: tobacco (Category→Brand Family→Variant→Product→Trade SKU→Factory SKU) and household (Brand→Price Band→Sub-brand→Form→Size→Flavor; TPM roll-up Division→Category→Brand→MPG→GTIN/UPC).
nodes.evidence: tobacco major Data Dictionary V4.0 · trade-transformation master-data spec v1.0 · HPC major group data warehouse Master Data List · TPM-program requirements
nodes.canon_evidence: tobacco major Data Dictionary V4.0 · trade-transformation master-data spec v1.0 · HPC major group data warehouse Master Data List · TPM-program requirements

nodes.name: CustomerOutlet
nodes.definition: The demand-side counterparty at every level. Layer model: Outlet → Delivery Point → Legal Customer → Retail Account → Supplier (multi-layer). Finance ladder: Class of Trade → Parent → Planning Account → Sold-to → Ship-to.
nodes.evidence: beverage bottler Outlet Data Solution · tobacco major Data Dictionary · HPC major Customer Profitability reference · the TPM program account model
nodes.canon_evidence: beverage bottler Outlet Data Solution · tobacco major Data Dictionary · HPC major Customer Profitability reference · the TPM program account model

nodes.name: GeographyNode / Territory
nodes.definition: Commercial geography — each field-force type may carry its own territory hierarchy over the same outlets. Chain: Outlet → Route/Beat → Territory → Area → Region → End Market → Cluster → Global Region; supply variant Sales Area ↔ Depot with lead-time maps.
nodes.evidence: TMD KPIs dimension sheets · trade-transformation master-data spec · tobacco major's driver-management forecasting model workshop
nodes.canon_evidence: TMD KPIs dimension sheets · trade-transformation master-data spec · tobacco major's driver-management forecasting model workshop

nodes.name: TimePeriod
nodes.definition: Dual calendar/fiscal date spine plus the FMCG-specific cycle/campaign grain. Conventions: MTD/QTD/YTD/CTD + prior-period comparatives; performance period vs posting period; as-is vs as-was reporting.
nodes.evidence: Indian FMCG major MT date dimension · tobacco major CC DATE_DIM · HPC major customer-profitability reference · CPG Template principles
nodes.canon_evidence: Indian FMCG major MT date dimension · tobacco major CC DATE_DIM · HPC major customer-profitability reference · CPG Template principles

nodes.name: OrganizationNode
nodes.definition: Company → division/BU → function → cost/profit center → role → employee. Roles are first-class: KPI dictionaries assign each metric an owning role dashboard with RAG thresholds (line of sight).
nodes.evidence: tobacco major Outlet Dashboard specs · HPC major dashboard landscapes · bakery group SCM org charts
nodes.canon_evidence: tobacco major Outlet Dashboard specs · HPC major dashboard landscapes · bakery group SCM org charts

nodes.name: Distributor / Wholesaler
nodes.definition: The indirect-RtM intermediary carrying the three sales flows: primary (manufacturer→distributor, sell-in), secondary (distributor→outlet, sell-out), tertiary (outlet→consumer).
nodes.evidence: food major TM&D analytics + a distributor-reporting platform RFP · bakery group / diversified manufacturer secondary-sales model · tobacco major DSS workstream
nodes.canon_evidence: food major TM&D analytics + a distributor-reporting platform RFP · bakery group / diversified manufacturer secondary-sales model · tobacco major DSS workstream

nodes.name: FieldForceRep
nodes.definition: The field seller/merchandiser. Call economics derived per rep: productive-call %, average vs break-even drop size, plan/route/time-standard adherence.
nodes.evidence: field performance-management model · TMD KPIs · salesforce-incentive deck
nodes.canon_evidence: field performance-management model · TMD KPIs · salesforce-incentive deck

nodes.name: CoveragePlan (TCP / TCR)
nodes.definition: Decides who visits which outlet how often. TCP sets universe/FF-type/frequency; TCR is the periodic capacity-vs-demand review consolidating workload from coverage, assortment, media and incentive plans with scenario levers.
nodes.evidence: SAO Toolkit · TCR Final process flow · trade-planning analysis deck
nodes.canon_evidence: SAO Toolkit · TCR Final process flow · trade-planning analysis deck

nodes.name: AssortmentPlan (SAO / SAT)
nodes.definition: Check→Plan→Act assortment object: core range / must-stock lists by outlet cluster, target distribution by SKU, rationalization; SAT is the outlet-level target whose achievement is SAT compliance %.
nodes.evidence: SAO Toolkit (+ SKU Distribution Optimiser & Assortment Generator)
nodes.canon_evidence: SAO Toolkit (+ SKU Distribution Optimiser & Assortment Generator)

nodes.name: CallVisit
nodes.definition: The atomic execution event: activities executing plans, surveys, stock count, audit, order capture — with GPS stamp and productive/partial/unproductive outcome.
nodes.evidence: trade-execution scope document · Execution@Outlet user journey · tobacco major Data Dictionary (Call, Survey suite)
nodes.canon_evidence: trade-execution scope document · Execution@Outlet user journey · tobacco major Data Dictionary (Call, Survey suite)

nodes.name: RetailAudit
nodes.definition: Per product × outlet × date: isDistributed, isAvailable (→ OOS derived), facings, POSM inventory, planogram compliance, observed RSP (→ price-compliance index). External twin: Nielsen retail audit.
nodes.evidence: tobacco major Data Dictionary Retail Audit entity · TMD KPI definitions · Indian FMCG major MT OOS/SOS audit facts
nodes.canon_evidence: tobacco major Data Dictionary Retail Audit entity · TMD KPI definitions · Indian FMCG major MT OOS/SOS audit facts

nodes.name: SuggestedOrder (SOQ)
nodes.definition: Recommendation object: baseline forecast + collaborative-filtering order enhancement → suggested quantity; tracked via acceptance, execution rate, serviceability (~85% baseline accuracy reported).
nodes.evidence: HPC major S&M analytics deck (AOP/ASOP) · field performance-management model
nodes.canon_evidence: HPC major S&M analytics deck (AOP/ASOP) · field performance-management model

nodes.name: TradeInvestment (TCI) / IncentiveScheme (CIS)
nodes.definition: The customer-facing money: front margin (customer's earn) + back-margin buckets; SONA and CROI derived. CIS: outlet-level incentive schemes with PfP/PfC buckets, enrolment, reward ledger, disputes.
nodes.evidence: legacy trade-platform customer scorecard · trade-terms policy manual · CIS PfP/PfC KPI sub-catalog · B2B Engagement Platform requirements
nodes.canon_evidence: legacy trade-platform customer scorecard · trade-terms policy manual · CIS PfP/PfC KPI sub-catalog · B2B Engagement Platform requirements

nodes.name: AccountPlan
nodes.definition: Keyed planning account × brand × year; parent of promotions. Carries volume method (demand-planning baseline / % historic shipments / manual), loaded targets, plan rates, shipment-drop profiles and the approval state model.
nodes.evidence: HPC-major TPM program Account Plan/Checkbook/SVP design · consumer-products manufacturer TPM manual
nodes.canon_evidence: HPC-major TPM program Account Plan/Checkbook/SVP design · consumer-products manufacturer TPM manual

nodes.name: Promotion
nodes.definition: The promo event: status lifecycle Draft→Submitted→Planned→Committed→Closed with re-approval on budget breach; tactics; uplift% sourced from lift tables/TPO/manual; grain header→MPG→UPC-week; dead-net-price guardrail.
nodes.evidence: consumer-products manufacturer + the TPM program promotion-planning requirements · beauty major EMEA RFP
nodes.canon_evidence: consumer-products manufacturer + the TPM program promotion-planning requirements · beauty major EMEA RFP

nodes.name: Deal
nodes.definition: Settlement-facing child of a promotion: variable (off-invoice, bill-back, scan) or fixed (feature, display, slotting, overlay); cost = volume × rate × redemption% or lump sum; identifies the fund/GL it spends against.
nodes.evidence: the TPM program Deals & Settlements design · consumer-products manufacturer deductions requirements
nodes.canon_evidence: the TPM program Deals & Settlements design · consumer-products manufacturer deductions requirements

nodes.name: TradeFund / Checkbook
nodes.definition: Budget container mapped to GL codes with the lifecycle Budget → Planned → Committed → Expended → Free Balance (= budget − committed − expended); live accruals convert liability to expense on shipment; kept open ~1yr post plan-year.
nodes.evidence: consumer-products manufacturer Fund Management requirements · the TPM program checkbook design
nodes.canon_evidence: consumer-products manufacturer Fund Management requirements · the TPM program checkbook design

nodes.name: Deduction
nodes.definition: AR event — customer short-pays an invoice; matched to deals via resolutions (deal/no-deal), performance date must fall inside the deal window, reason code ties to GL; small deductions auto write-off; repay link for invalid ones.
nodes.evidence: consumer-products manufacturer Deductions/Claims/Settlement requirements · TPM-program as-built
nodes.canon_evidence: consumer-products manufacturer Deductions/Claims/Settlement requirements · TPM-program as-built

nodes.name: Claim / CheckRequest
nodes.definition: Customer- or broker-submitted settlement with deal and no-deal payments; remaining amount = request − deal − no-deal; SAP check/credit-memo round-trip; post-audit and pre-pay variants.
nodes.evidence: consumer-products manufacturer + the TPM program settlement requirements
nodes.canon_evidence: consumer-products manufacturer + the TPM program settlement requirements

nodes.name: PriceList / ADL
nodes.definition: Single list price + COGS + dead-net floors per country/division; ADL = account × product intersection carrying retail price, distribution flags with effective dates and store counts per GTIN (drives %ACV).
nodes.evidence: TPM-program requirements · beauty major price-group spec
nodes.canon_evidence: TPM-program requirements · beauty major price-group spec

nodes.name: LiftModel / TPO
nodes.definition: The econometric object: log-log mixed-effects demand model decomposing sales into base / trade promo / consumer promo / competition / halo / cannibalization; true lift & true ROI; what-if simulators and scheme recommendation engines.
nodes.evidence: global brewer TPO approach · beverage bottler Trade Analytics · smokeless-tobacco company workshop
nodes.canon_evidence: global brewer TPO approach · beverage bottler Trade Analytics · smokeless-tobacco company workshop

nodes.name: GrossToNetWaterfall
nodes.definition: The revenue-side P&L contract between the commercial domains and finance. Three verbatim instances: beer (GT → duty → conditional/unconditional discounts → NT), HPC (GS → SRA → trade → realized → net → GP → marketing profit), tobacco (CPTO net of tax → TCI → supplier share).
nodes.evidence: High Level PnL Structure xlsx · HPC major Customer Profitability reference · tobacco major trade-terms policy manual
nodes.canon_evidence: High Level PnL Structure xlsx · HPC major Customer Profitability reference · tobacco major trade-terms policy manual

nodes.name: Consumer / LoyaltyMember
nodes.definition: The end consumer with identity, demographics, contactability, tier and points; scored with engagement, share of wallet, churn propensity, NPS, LTV; ~68-column physical schema evidenced.
nodes.evidence: Shopperinsight customer attributes · CVM Data Dictionary · persona decks
nodes.canon_evidence: Shopperinsight customer attributes · CVM Data Dictionary · persona decks

nodes.name: Segment / Persona
nodes.definition: Segment: typed (value/behaviour/attitude) with parameters, centroids and archived assignments. Persona: narrative instance on micro-segments with propensity-score matching, evolution stages and functional/emotional needs; white-space method exposes underserved segments.
nodes.evidence: CVM data model · Persona Development Approach · a vaping product line lifecycle · brewer beer personas
nodes.canon_evidence: CVM data model · Persona Development Approach · a vaping product line lifecycle · brewer beer personas

nodes.name: Campaign
nodes.definition: Hierarchy Marketing Plan → Program → Stage → Campaign → Wave → Offer → Communication → Response; measured TG-vs-CG with incremental response/spend, cost and ROI; contact-fatigue rules.
nodes.evidence: Shopper Insights user guide · CVM metrics workbook
nodes.canon_evidence: Shopper Insights user guide · CVM metrics workbook

nodes.name: Touchpoint / MediaSpend
nodes.definition: Channel taxonomy (paid/owned/earned × ATL/BTL/TTL × digital × physical) and the Nielsen-style spend record: market → advertiser → category → product → media → network → outlet × period, with companion TRP data.
nodes.evidence: oral-care major media-spend & TRP samples · Traditional ATL/BTL deck · MPM KPI catalogue
nodes.canon_evidence: oral-care major media-spend & TRP samples · Traditional ATL/BTL deck · MPM KPI catalogue

nodes.name: CDPProfile / IdentityKey
nodes.definition: Identity resolution: hard keys (phone, email), private keys (cookie, device), soft keys (name, address, IP), unmatched pool re-matched later; pipeline sources → match → unified store → segmentation → activation/syndication. CDP ≠ DMP ≠ CRM distinctions evidenced.
nodes.evidence: Indian FMCG major CDP Technical Solution Design (AWS) · CDP assessment framework · a web-personalization CDP data model
nodes.canon_evidence: Indian FMCG major CDP Technical Solution Design (AWS) · CDP assessment framework · a web-personalization CDP data model

nodes.name: MarketResearch / SocialSignal
nodes.definition: MR study objects (U&A, concept test, conjoint/MaxDiff/TURF, NPS, brand equity) across the product lifecycle; social listening signals (mentions, sentiment, influencers, crisis alerts) as command-center consumables.
nodes.evidence: Market Research Overview · a social-listening platform · Rapid Insight hypothesis library
nodes.canon_evidence: Market Research Overview · a social-listening platform · Rapid Insight hypothesis library

nodes.name: DemandForecast
nodes.definition: The demand signal: FCSTRPT schema (demand unit/group/location, base vs non-base history & forecast), decomposition into base + influenced demand, driver models (WAS × seasonality × elasticity × calendar), 27-method library + ML, abnormal-demand log.
nodes.evidence: HPC major FCSTRPT export · tobacco major Demand Forecast Workshop (driver-management model) · Anaplan connected planning
nodes.canon_evidence: HPC major FCSTRPT export · tobacco major Demand Forecast Workshop (driver-management model) · Anaplan connected planning

nodes.name: S&OP Plan
nodes.definition: The 18-month rolling integrated plan run as a monthly 5-meeting cycle with named owners: Product Review → Demand Review → Supply & Material Review → Pre-S&OP → Executive S&OP; extends financially to gross profit and EBITDA with scenarios.
nodes.evidence: bakery group S&OP IT Roadmap (5 meetings, owners, weekly calendar) · consultancy/Anaplan variant
nodes.canon_evidence: bakery group S&OP IT Roadmap (5 meetings, owners, weekly calendar) · consultancy/Anaplan variant

nodes.name: SupplyPlan / RCCP
nodes.definition: Production & material response: requirement analyses, make-vs-subcontract, allocation & sourcing plans, constrained flags; RCCP maps SKU families to factory lines with speeds and scenario levers (speed/OEE, shift pattern, add line).
nodes.evidence: Anaplan SC planning deck · bakery group planning org
nodes.canon_evidence: Anaplan SC planning deck · bakery group planning org

nodes.name: InventoryPosition / Policy
nodes.definition: Position per SKU × location (net stock, open orders, inbound STOs, days of supply) and MEIO-optimized policy: segmentation → service targets → optimization minimizing carrying + lost-sales + replenishment cost; slow-moving (>18d) and remnant (>90d) flags.
nodes.evidence: MEIO framework (Anaplan deck) · HPC major SMR reports & stock classes
nodes.canon_evidence: MEIO framework (Anaplan deck) · HPC major SMR reports & stock classes

nodes.name: NetworkNode / Lane
nodes.definition: Physical network: supplier → factory → hub → RDC/DC/wholesale point → customer; nodes carry capacity, costs and days-of-supply norms; lanes carry mode, freight cost, lead time, FTL constraints. Redesign is a regular exercise.
nodes.evidence: Network Design & Optimization RACI (Llamasoft/JDA) · industry benchmark (2016/18) benchmark
nodes.canon_evidence: Network Design & Optimization RACI (Llamasoft/JDA) · industry benchmark (2016/18) benchmark

nodes.name: SupplyOrders (SO/STO/PO/Shipment)
nodes.definition: The transactional movement objects: sales orders, stock transfer orders, purchase orders (PO vs non-PO), shipments with carriers and late-reason categories, trailer loads, pallets, invoices (3-way match).
nodes.evidence: HPC major SC metric model & information model
nodes.canon_evidence: HPC major SC metric model & information model

nodes.name: Supplier / ProcurementCategory
nodes.definition: Vendor master with OTIF, lead time, reject/waiver rates and scorecards; category taxonomy direct (raw materials, packaging, logistics) vs indirect & traded; savings initiatives with the pipeline identified → approved → budgeted → booked and the finance-to-procurement bridge.
nodes.evidence: bakery group procurement org + dashboard vision · strategy consultancy digital-procurement booklet (12 use cases)
nodes.canon_evidence: bakery group procurement org + dashboard vision · strategy consultancy digital-procurement booklet (12 use cases)

nodes.name: Plant / Line / Machine
nodes.definition: Region → site → production line → machine → shift → operator; carries line speeds, changeover matrices, raw OEE (observed ~40–50% on real lines) and capacity utilization.
nodes.evidence: HPC major plant financial report + manufacturing metric model · tobacco major global MES program
nodes.canon_evidence: HPC major plant financial report + manufacturing metric model · tobacco major global MES program

nodes.name: ProductionOrder / BOM
nodes.definition: The make event: planned vs actual quantity, TECO timestamp (→ production lead time), yield, verbatim variance formulas (labour efficiency, material usage/price); BOM with costing and the 42-day on-time release rule.
nodes.evidence: HPC major manufacturing metric model · quality scorecard
nodes.canon_evidence: HPC major manufacturing metric model · quality scorecard

nodes.name: Maintenance / Quality / LossEvent
nodes.definition: Maintenance (notification→order, MTTR/MTBF, preventive vs breakdown), quality records (NCR, complaints PPM, RFT, rework/recall, vendor rejects) and the OEE loss tree (availability / performance / quality losses) with waste causality.
nodes.evidence: HPC major metric model — manufacturing (verbatim formulas) · tobacco major digital-manufacturing booklet
nodes.canon_evidence: HPC major metric model — manufacturing (verbatim formulas) · tobacco major digital-manufacturing booklet

nodes.name: NPDProject
nodes.definition: The innovation pipeline object: gate status, project class, launch window × country, pipeline value (k€) with deltas vs prior snapshot, FY1/Y2 sales & GP%, health RAGs, private-label and on-hold flags.
nodes.evidence: bakery group NPD pipeline + 1-pager · HPC major NPI review

nodes.name: Gate
nodes.definition: Stage-gate governance: Discovery → Charter → Feasibility → Development → Qualification → SKU/Launch approval → Implementation (or G1/G2 embedded in the S&OP cycle); investment decisions precede approval.

nodes.canon_evidence: HPC major NPD Apr-16 NPI review · bakery group gate labels

nodes.name: LaunchRecord
nodes.definition: Per SKU × retailer: presentation date, listing decision, in-store date target vs actual, marketing & production dates, distribution build (store counts, WTD%), price point, exclusivity — reviewed post-launch vs the launchgate case.

nodes.canon_evidence: HPC major NPD Tracker 2016 · UK NPD 2015 summary

nodes.name: PnL ReportingLineItem

nodes.name: PlanningVersion / Scenario
nodes.definition: Version set: actual · plan/budget (annual plan, 1YP) · reforecasts (PPR-n = n months actual + remainder forecast) · latest estimate · prior year · constant-FX variants · scenarios; performance vs posting period; organic flags; ZBB workflow.

nodes.name: ProfitabilityRecord

nodes.canon_evidence: nutrition group metric lists + debtor dashboards (verbatim formulas) · HPC major working-capital report

nodes.definition: The governance object: 4 operating-model structure options, hub-spoke-crew roles, 90-day scorecards and SLA tiers; v1.1 adds the CFO-agenda pillars, the 4-phase finance-transformation lifecycle, the Lagging→Pioneering maturity model, shared-services scope and finance-cost benchmarks (median 1.24% of sales, best-in-class 0.61%; world-class close ≈2 days).

nodes.definition: The technology object finance runs on: the canonical five-component CPM suite (BP&F, profitability modeling, strategy management, consolidation & close, reporting & disclosure), a 17-dimension reference planning model, the ABC allocation engine's calculation path, implementation methodology (phased releases, parallel run, hypercare; failure statistics), and the platform landscape with cloud-vs-on-premise economics.
